status: Placement-stage plan-view envelopes of exposed metal at each M4 stud; replace with measured hardware before fabrication.

ring_lug.part: Wurth 5580406 (M4 ring, 10 mm wide, 21 mm long)
ring_lug.note: Exposed metal from the ring edge behind the stud to the barrel end; insulated cable beyond.

bare_stud.part: M4 screw head with washer (DIN 125 M4, 9 mm OD)
bare_stud.note: Screw and washer fitted without a lug.

min_clearance_mm.note: Electrical floors match the PCB rules. Mechanical: installed items may not overlap each other or any component other than the studs they mount on, independent of net membership.

link_strap.part: Removable link strap, custom: tinned copper flat bar 10.0 mm wide x 1.5 mm thick x 23.0 mm long, two 4.3 mm holes at 13.0 mm pitch (5.0 mm from each end); M4 x 8 pan-head screws with spring and plain washers. PROVISIONAL: drawing and current rating to confirm.
link_strap.note: One rigid part per link, fitted over both studs of a row; replaces two lugs, so nothing stacks or overlaps.

normal.description: Both bring-up links fitted as removable straps; coil connected.

bring_up.description: Both straps removed; floating bench supply on the bus studs, leads leaving the left edge; rectifier studs bare and mains-live.

cable_exits.J6: PE branch wire, vertical exit to the chassis stud; not in the protective-earth path
